page.overview:
Who is Palace Guard?

The Palace Guard, or simply Guard, is an Adventurers Orient Expedition minifigure released in 2003.

The Palace Guard wears a black turban, dark grey pants, and a bright blue shirt with a green silk belt and red diamond-shaped decorations. He has a small dagger in his belt. His hair is black, and some of it peeks out of his turban. He has lots of black stubble and a smirking expression.

In Secret of Scorpion Palace, the Guards wear black robes with yellow belts and trimmings and a blue scorpion emblem on their backs.

The Palace Guards, as their title suggests, guard the Scorpion Palace. They act as the evil minions of Maharaja Lallu. In the online comics and 4215473 Die Suche nach dem Goldenen Drachen, two Guards hold Babloo prisoner while Lallu interrogates him, and they are ordered to chase after Johnny Thunder when he rescues the boy. In the 7418 set comic, a Guard helps Lallu and Lord Sam Sinister capture Johnny Thunder and Dr. Kilroy, but he is chased away by the rolling boulder; in Die Suche nach dem Goldenen Drachen, the Guards are unable to stop Babloo and his elephants from overthrowing the Maharaja.
